title: fix(lint): a record:related_list judges its child refs on its dataSource and its parent ref on parentDataSource, else the inherited object (#23207)
body:
Fixes #23207

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`page-field-unknown` now checks each of a `record:related_list`'s two bindings against its own object (`packages/lint/src/validate-page-field-bindings.ts`, `RELATED_LIST_TYPE` branch):

- **Child refs** (`columns`, `sort`, `filter`, `relationshipField`, `add.linkField`) are checked against the node-level `dataSource.object` when the list binds its rows that way, else against `properties.objectName`. `dataSource.object` wins when both are present.
- **The parent ref** (`relationshipValueField`) is checked against `parentDataSource.object` when the list declares it, else against the object the list **inherits**: its container's binding, else the page object. The node's own child `dataSource` is never used for it.
- The add picker is unchanged: it is still checked against `add.picker.object`.

Before this change, a `dataSource`-bound list checked `relationshipValueField` against the CHILD and reported a field of the parent as missing (the card's false finding). Its child columns were not checked at all, because only `properties.objectName` was read for the child.

## `page-walk.ts`: one additive field, and why

`WalkedComponent` gains an optional `inheritedObject`: the object a component inherits (its container's resolved binding, else `page.object`) before its own `dataSource.object` / `properties.object` override is applied. `objectName` is resolved exactly as before, so every other rule built on the walk is unaffected.

The walk had to change because nothing else exposes the inherited object. The rule only sees `objectName`, which already includes the node's own `dataSource`. Using `page.object` instead would change the existing behaviour for a related list nested in a `dataSource`-bound container: today that list checks its parent ref against the container's object (pin: "a list nested in a dataSource-bound container resolves its parent ref on the container object").

## The `parentDataSource` reading

The parent side reads `parentDataSource.object` per the seat's reading on the card (comment 6175263895, option A). That comment quotes triage 6143034845: "When ruling B's parent-binding key lands (objectstack #23134), the parent side reads it". The key landed in PR #23205 (`4cc3ff9dc`), and ruling B (objectui#12296, `6137226306`) names `parentDataSource` as the parent binding. Measured reach: zero `parentDataSource` writers in `examples/` or `packages/` at `869a381dc9`, and no renderer reads the key yet (the spec describe marks it PLANNED).

## Probe: before and after

A temporary test was run and then deleted. Objects: `pg` is the page object (field `title`), `kid` is the child (fields `name`, `pg_ref`), `par` is `parentDataSource.object` (field `name`).

| case | shape | `relationshipValueField` | `869a381dc9` (main) | `b9007d86b9` (split only) | this PR (split + A) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | `parentDataSource: par`, `properties.objectName: kid`, no `dataSource` | `name` (on par and kid, not pg) | finding: not on `pg` | finding: not on `pg` | **no finding** (on `par`) |
| B | `dataSource: kid` + `parentDataSource: par` | `name` | no finding (judged on `kid`) | NEW false finding: not on `pg` | **no finding** (on `par`) |
| C | `dataSource: kid` + `parentDataSource: par` | `title` (on pg only) | finding: not on `kid` (wrong object) | no finding (on `pg`) | **finding: not on `par`** |

Case A: main reported a field of the declared parent as missing from the page. That was a false finding under the declared contract, and this PR no longer reports it (pin: "a properties.objectName list with parentDataSource also resolves its parent ref on that object"). The pins for the card's own probe cases B and C are "a list with parentDataSource resolves relationshipValueField on that object: no finding" and "... reports a parent ref its declared parent lacks, against that parent".

## Severity and `--strict` (`Clause-②: no`)

These refs are checked with the `skipped` consequence, so `page-field-unknown` stays a **warning**. Default `os validate` / `os lint` / `os build` accept every stack they accepted before. Under `--strict` (warnings are treated as errors), a `dataSource`-bound list with a misspelled child column can now fail a stack that used to pass, because that column was not checked before. The `patch` changeset `.changeset/23207-related-list-binding-split.md` for `@objectstack/lint` says so.

## Tests and evidence (head `2dbc3423fe`, after merging `origin/main`)

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`, run through `os-verify-lock`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 139 passed (139), Tests 6743 passed (6743).
- New pins: 10 in `validate-page-field-bindings.test.ts` (describe "a related list splits its child and parent bindings") and 2 in `page-walk.test.ts` (`inheritedObject`).
- Pin sweep: `git grep` for `relationshipValueField` and for the message `is not a field on object` across the repo (examples included) finds no test pinning the old false finding, so there was nothing to flip.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run test:repo`: `VERDICT command-exit 0`, Test Files 61 passed (61), Tests 1033 passed (1033).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 commands. All 62 were run with exit codes recorded, and `--ran` reconciles: "62 derived, 61 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". Results: 61 exit 0. `check:lean-entry-closure` first exited 3 (objectql dist absent); after `@objectstack/objectql...` was built it gave exit 0. NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: PREREQUISITE NOT MET, it needs a full `pnpm build` of 86 packages this diff does not touch (left to CI).

## Ablations

Each ablation was run on a committed tree. The restore was checked by comparing the file's hash with the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` was empty afterwards.

1. **The split** (`validate-page-field-bindings.ts` replaced by its `869a381dc9` blob; anchor counts `split.parent, inheritedObject` 1 to 0, `split.parent, objectName` 0 to 1): 6 failed, 39 passed. The 6 failures are the new `dataSource`-bound and nested pins. The `properties.objectName` control stays green, which is correct: it passes before and after.
2. **The `parentDataSource` branch** (`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor `strName(parentDataSource?.object) ?? inheritedObject` changed to `inheritedObject`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `47498745686a` to `42abbe44b840`): 3 failed, 45 passed. The 3 failures are the three `parentDataSource` pins. The restore blob equals the HEAD blob.

## Acceptance notes

- Landing spot as the claim states, plus the additive `page-walk.ts` field explained above. `page-walk.ts`'s generic `objectName` resolution is unchanged.
